burke_sensitivity_curve_source: exact original March2026 Burke-main IF JSONs (verbatim curve preserved)
burke_sensitivity_impact_source: recomputed inside Masselot-main variant namespace using variant hazard/exposures
burke_recompute_audit_skip_reason: Burke-main reference for 'copenhagen' was computed on Track-B (exceedance hazard) but this Masselot-main variant runs on the standard absolute-T track (hazard.units='degc (daily mean)'). The row-by-row audit would compare different physical quantities, so it is skipped here. The variant Burke recomputed numbers in this directory are honest 'Burke applied to the same hazard as Masselot' sensitivities; they are intentionally NOT expected to match the original Burke-main Track-B numbers.
burke_audit_dependency: Burke recompute audit reads original Burke-main annual death CSVs from outputs/{city}/interim/. This is the only remaining dependency on the Burke-main workflow; Burke impact numbers themselves are recomputed in the variant namespace.
compatibility_note: if_curves_by_year_copenhagen.json is the downstream compatibility filename for the main deterministic IF. In this variant its true source is Masselot / masselot_tail, recorded in the JSON metadata.
